sandboxNextStepWindows: Safe next step: complete the one-time sandbox setup as administrator (Settings → Security & Sandbox), then retry. Or, if you are sure the command is safe, choose "once" in the approval card. Switching to full-access is not recommended — it disables all isolation.
sandboxNextStepResultUnknown: Safe next step: do not treat this as success. When you need the real result, run the same command yourself in a terminal, or switch to unsandboxed mode (which is explicitly marked as unisolated).
